company_tagline: Audit, improve, and prove website performance

essentials.name: Essentials
essentials.summary: Fix high and medium priority findings from the audit.
includes: Technical SEO basics (titles, meta, headings, robots/sitemap)
HTTPS / SSL trust fixes in scope

growth.name: Growth
growth.summary: Essentials plus UX/content improvements and performance pass.
includes: Performance improvements for Core Web Vitals issues
Homepage messaging and conversion path polish

redesign.name: Redesign
redesign.summary: Growth plus visual redesign direction and homepage rebuild.
includes: Launch QA and final verification crawl

monitoring.name: Monthly monitoring
monitoring.summary: Monthly re-crawl, score tracking, and findings diff report.

out_of_scope_defaults: Copywriting for the entire site (unless selected)
